FN-DGQZINT-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 402
Committee: Urban and Rural Development Sponsor: Representatives Curtis Travis
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/07/2025
House Bill 402 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Legislative Services Agency
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost of any additional staff or software
necessary to accomplish the provisions of this bill.
